name: keep
title: Keep: Plain Words Become a Script
html:
Keep: Plain Words Become a Script

Once {watch} is answered,
  at {pr}, merge it by
  squashing `as merged`
➜
- once-answered:
    reply: watch
    steps:
      - act: scm:merge
        fields: { method: squash }
        then:
          - check: merged is true
          - keep-as: merged
At {jenkins}, build commit
  {merged.merge_commit_sha} `as build`
Once {build} is answered,
  follow its in-reply-to link
  Run the smoke script it
  links as ci:smoke-test …
➜
- ask: ci:build
  fields: { commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha} }
  reply: build
- once-answered: { reply: build }
  - follow: hr:in-reply-to
    - run-script: ci:smoke-test
      on-link: ci:deployment
If {smoke.passed}, at {dev},
  … promote commit …, citing
  {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of}
Otherwise, at {pr}, act
  scm:comment …
➜
- given: smoke.passed is true
  then:
    - act: env:promote
      fields:
        commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
        smoke: # review: the reasoner chose it
  otherwise:
    - act: scm:comment

Shortened to fit; the whole script is one click away. Inputs stay inputs: the pull request, the addresses, the book to renew.

the kept script, whole
say: Here's what artie generate kept, next to the words it came from. Once the watch is answered, merge it by squashing: that became once-answered, an act on scm:merge with method squash, and a check that it really merged. Build it and smoke-test what the build links: an ask on ci:build with a reply, a follow of the reply's in-reply-to link, and a run-script on the smoke test the build links, on the deployment it links. And the if-otherwise line became given, then, otherwise. Notice the one review mark. Citing N of M scenarios passed took judgment once; Claude shaped it into the form's smoke field, and the script says so, so a person checks it before it's kept.

deck:fragment.name: kept
deck:fragment.label: The kept script, whole (release.heart.yaml)
deck:fragment.text:
steps:
  - act: scm:pulls-get
    fields:
      owner: ${owner}
      repo: ${repo}
      pull_number: ${pull}
    intent: Open pull request ${pull} of ${owner}/${repo}
    then:
      - keep-as: pr
  - enter: ${watcher}
    steps:
      - ask: watcher:watch
        fields:
          resource: ${pr.@self}
          offers: scm:merge
        reply: watch
  - once-answered:
      reply: watch
      steps:
        - enter: ${pr.@self}
          steps:
            - act: scm:merge
              fields:
                method: squash
              intent: merge it by squashing
              then:
                - check:
                    - field: state
                      is: closed
                    - field: merged
                      is: true
                    - field: mergeable_state
                      is: unknown
                - keep-as: merged
  - enter: ${jenkins}
    steps:
      - ask: ci:build
        fields:
          commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
        reply: build
  - once-answered:
      reply: build
      steps:
        - follow: hr:in-reply-to
          intent: follow its in-reply-to link to the build
          then:
            - run-script: ci:smoke-test
              on-link: ci:deployment
              inputs:
                book: ${book}
                author: ${author}
                renewable: ${renewable}
                problem: ${problem}
                comment: ${comment}
              as: smoke
  - given:
      - at: smoke
        field: passed
        is: true
    then:
      - enter: ${dev}
        steps:
          - act: env:get-environment
            fields:
              id: ${environment}
            inferred: get environment ${environment}
            from-intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
            then:
              - act: env:promote
                fields:
                  commit: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
                  smoke: # review: the reasoner chose it, asked "promote commit 30a0fa96e3eed2ae20b2b5fa7613a115d56312a3, citing 5 of 5 scenarios passed"
                    passed: ${smoke.passing}
                    of: ${smoke.of}
                intent: open environment ${environment} and promote commit {merged.merge_commit_sha}, citing {smoke.passing} of {smoke.of} scenarios passed
                then:
                  - check:
                      - field: commit
                        is: ${merged.merge_commit_sha}
    otherwise:
      - at: ${pr.@self}
        steps:
          - act: scm:comment
            fields:
              body: "Not promoted to Dev: smoke scenarios ${smoke.failed} failed."
